newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.051pts to 100.301.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.051pts to 100.301.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.051 points in Thursday's trading to 100.301, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.002 points to 2.560 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.001 points to 96.354, the bank said, while the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.343 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 1.014 points to 1,161.977.
